questions.question: Unix nima va Unix-like (Unix-based) OS deganda nima tushuniladi?
questions.explanation: Unix — 1969 Bell Labs (Thompson, Ritchie), C'da yozilgan ko'p user'li OS. Unix-like — Unix falsafasi va POSIX API'ni takrorlaydigan OS'lar (Linux, BSD, macOS).

questions.question: Unix falsafasi nima? Asosiy tamoyillari.
questions.explanation: Bitta ish — yaxshi bajar; dasturlar birlashadi (pipe); matn — universal interfeys; hamma narsa fayl.

questions.question: Linux — OS'mi yoki kernel? GNU/Linux nima?
questions.explanation: Linux — faqat kernel (Torvalds, 1991). To'liq OS = kernel + GNU userland (bash, coreutils, glibc) + init + paketlar = distributiv.

questions.question: POSIX nima va nega muhim?
questions.explanation: IEEE standarti: shell, utilitlar, C API (fork, exec, open, pthread). POSIX'ga yozilgan skript/kod Linux, BSD, macOS'da ishlaydi.

questions.question: Asosiy Linux distributiv oilalari qaysilar?
questions.explanation: Debian (Ubuntu) — apt/.deb; RHEL (Fedora, Rocky, Alma, CentOS Stream) — dnf/.rpm; SUSE — zypper; Arch — pacman; Alpine — apk/musl.

questions.question: LTS, rolling release va point release farqi? Production uchun qaysi?
questions.explanation: LTS/point — barqaror versiya, faqat security fix (Ubuntu LTS 5 yil, RHEL 10 yil). Rolling (Arch) — doim eng yangi, sinish xavfi. Production — LTS.

questions.question: Alpine (musl) vs Debian/Ubuntu (glibc) bazaviy image: qanday farq va gotcha?
questions.explanation: Alpine kichik (~5MB), musl libc. Gotcha: glibc'ga bog'langan binary ishlamaydi, DNS resolver farqi, ba'zi workload'da sekin malloc, Python wheel yo'q.

questions.question: Linux, BSD va macOS farqi (DevOps nuqtai nazaridan)?
questions.explanation: Linux — kernel + turli userland; BSD — kernel+userland bitta loyiha; macOS — XNU (Mach+BSD). Utilitlar farqi: GNU vs BSD `sed -i`, `date`, `find`.

questions.question: Production uchun distributiv tanlashda qaysi mezonlarga qaraysan?
questions.explanation: Support muddati, security patch tezligi, vendor/sertifikat (DB, cloud), jamoa tajribasi, kernel versiyasi (eBPF, cgroup v2), image hajmi, compliance (FIPS, CIS).

questions.question: Immutable/minimal host OS (Flatcar, Bottlerocket, Talos) nima va nega?
questions.explanation: Read-only root, paket menejer yo'q, atomik A/B yangilanish, faqat konteyner ishlatadi. Kichik attack surface, drift yo'q, rollback oson.

questions.question: Kernel versiyasi va distributiv versiyasi nega alohida? `uname -r` nima beradi?
questions.explanation: Distro kernel'ni o'zi build qiladi va patch backport qiladi. `5.14.0-427.el9` — RHEL kernel, upstream 5.14 emas, yangi fix'lar bor.
